description: This file is a server-side script for a public invoice portal page in a SvelteKit application. It loads invoice data based on a token parameter, fetches invoice details from an API, and handles errors appropriately. The function `load` supplies data to the page component for rendering invoice details.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function to load invoice data based on URL parameters, fetching invoice details from an API, validating the response, and returning structured data for page rendering.
